records.receipt-2:
On 31 August 2020, the Security Council concluded a written vote on draft S/2020/852, submitted by Indonesia. The draft proposed comprehensive prosecution, rehabilitation and reintegration strategies for foreign terrorist fighters and related cases. It received 14 votes in favour, one against and no abstentions. The United States cast the only negative vote. The draft was not adopted because that negative vote was cast by a permanent member. The United States vetoed the draft because it opposed the proposed prosecution strategies, while Russia supported it to promote accountability but reserved its position regarding repatriation from Syria and Iraq. It received 14 votes in favour, one against and no abstentions. The United States cast the only negative vote. The draft was not adopted because that negative vote was cast by a permanent member.
